paragraphs: Chapter 598
Episode 156. Chaos Purification (2)
At Ban's command, the Myungwang people swiftly began to clean up the banquet hall.
As Jin was about to help clean up, King Otu Boras approached him.
"Keke, Jin, you just stay still. Let's just goof around with me."
"Boras, my brother."

"As you may have already felt, Brother Ban firmly believes that you will overcome the primordial chaos. The faith of the great Myungwang divine warrior has never been wrong... Well, it's been wrong a few times. Hmm."
"Ah, that's really true."
"Anyway, don't worry too much. I, Boras, will create a great chaos extraction auxiliary device for you."
That was the reason why Ban said that some preparation was needed before starting chaos purification.
King Otu Boras, the greatest blacksmith in the history of the Myungwang people, had to make something to help Ban.
"Chaos extraction auxiliary device?"
"It's a device that assists the divine warriors in extracting chaos from you more easily. It also improves stability."
"Can divine warriors extract chaos from others? Even if it's primordial chaos?"
"Yes, it's been done before."
Sadness filled Boras's eyes. He was thinking of his brothers who had been tainted by primordial chaos before their destruction.
"Of course... there must be side effects, right? Like becoming an insect, as you guys mentioned earlier."
"That's right. There were expected side effects when injecting divine blood, too. But the result was perfect. Jin, you're someone who can overcome trials and challenges, so this will end well, too."
Jin decided not to ask for more details.
In fact, he had no choice. If he feared the side effects and refused purification, the only future left for Jin would be death or a more miserable outcome.

'I'll just be more nervous if I know more. Anyway, if I'm going to attempt purification, I have to trust and follow my brothers. And if the divine warriors have a way, when I can get my brothers out... I can treat others as well.'
It was unknown when the Myungwang people could be taken out as a reward. Moreover, since there were serious side effects, it might not be of much help to other infected people.
'I hope to find a way to reduce side effects through my chaos purification.'
The banquet hall cleanup was finished.
Except for Ban and Boras, the rest of the Myungwang people and Jin moved to the training ground.
They had been drinking all night, but it didn't affect the sparring at all.
"Let's decide who will spar with Jin first by playing rock-paper-scissors."
"Rock-paper-scissors is fair!"
At the words of the ordinary warriors, including Shaku, King Ilto Baltirok nodded.
"Brothers, this time only us, the warrior kings, will assess Jin's skills."
"Are you going to be so unfair, warrior kings?"
"The divine warrior brothers told us not to train with Jin through sparring, but to check his achievements. So, this sparring is a checkup process for purification."
"Ugh, it feels so unfair."
"If it's unfair, let other brothers be warrior kings too. Hahaha. If the ordinary warrior brothers were to check Jin's skills, unnecessary accidents could happen."
The twelfth warrior king, 'Teto,' stuck out his tongue and teased the ordinary warriors.
At that, the second warrior king 'Lumora' smacked Teto in the back of the head once.
Crack!
It sounded like a chunk of iron was being split.
"How many times do I have to tell you to speak nicely, Twelfth Warrior King Brother. You'll get hated by the brothers."
"Ugh! I only told the truth. And no one hates me. Everyone knows I just speak without thinking."
"Anyway, brothers. The Twelfth Warrior King is not wrong. The ordinary warrior brothers just watch, and the warrior kings will take turns checking Jin's skills."
Lumora pushed Teto's back.
"Let's start with the Twelfth Warrior King. The rest of the Warrior Kings, gather here, let's do rock-paper-scissors."
"Hehehe, as expected! The second warrior king brother is the best, thinking of me even though he hits me from time to time."
Teto lightly rotated his spear and moved to the center of the training ground. He was a user of the spear among the Myungwang swords.
Jin didn't have much experience with the character called Teto in the first and second training.
However, one thing was certain.
"I'll tell you in advance, I'm the weakest among the warrior king brothers."
Jin laughed. It was the reason why Lumora brought Teto out first.
"I know, Brother Teto. I heard you barely made it as a warrior king."
"Even so, you won't be able to focus on my dazzling spear skill."
Shush-!
As soon as he finished speaking, Teto thrust his spear.
It was a clear attack targeting the neck. If Jin had been caught off guard and failed to dodge, it could have easily led to death or a fatal injury.
Brothers never maim each other or threaten each other's lives. Teto's attack violated that principle, but no one pointed it out.
Everyone was certain that Jin wouldn't fall for Teto's surprise attack, even though it was a 'Warrior King's' surprise attack.
"Hahaha! As expected, you've become stronger, Brother Jin!"
"You should take it more seriously, Brother Teto."
Although he responded in a cold tone, Jin felt his heart flutter at the fact that he was finally being recognized.
The only people who could spar like this with a Warrior King were the same Warrior Kings and the Divine Warriors.
'Even during the last training session, the Brother Kings, when they fought me, were only playing around like they were entertaining a child. But now it's completely different...'
Fzzzt!
Lightning surged around Sigmund. After the first exchange began quickly and lightly, the entire training ground was filled with the two's lightning aura in less than five moves.
There was no issue with the shockwaves since the audience were the strongest battle race in history.
The lightning aura unleashed by the Brother Kings and ordinary warriors formed a thick protective shield across the entire training ground.
Of course, as long as they didn't actually violate the rules of brotherly combat. Neither of them could use their ultimate techniques or secret arts.
It could have been possible if one side was overwhelmingly stronger, but the difference between Teto and Jin wasn't that large.
So, both of them had to fight using only an energy level that wouldn't end the fight.
It naturally turned into a contest of techniques, not strength.
"If we can't use our lightning auras properly, we'll lose easily."
"Once Jin Brother gets his distance, it's over."
"Although it seems almost impossible to get that distance."
As they said, Jin couldn't shorten the distance at all. As the fight dragged on, Teto's spear dominated a larger area, and Jin's territory narrowed.
'I expected the difference to be less if we're fighting with similar levels of power and pure weapon skills.'
That was not the case.
Teto's spear, which he himself described as the weakest, was hard to handle, just as he had initially anticipated.
"Hehehe, this time it's the left! Actually, it's the right!"
The afterimages stretched out.

"Left, right, left! Left! Soft, medium, soft! Oh, you're blocking well. But you couldn't avoid the thigh, could you? Ah, it's a pity. Jin Brother, you've got a bruise on your right cheek following your thigh!"
Jin felt like he was getting hot due to Teto's sneaky expression and tone.
It was not a misconception.
Jin, in fact, felt a sudden explosion of anger. And as his anger grew like a snowball, his eyes looking at the fight became clearer and his body felt lighter.
Kang!
The swords and spears stuck tightly together due to the repelling force of the Blade King's ordinary suppression that both unfolded at the same time.
For Teto, he intentionally used the same suppression with their weapons stuck together to further provoke Jin.
If their weapons are tied like this, they can only exchange punches with the remaining arm.

"Jin Brother is a bit weak in bare-handed combat, right? That's why right after you became our true brother, you requested a hand-to-hand combat with Shaku Brother and got beaten up badly. And I, of course, have a punch that's even better than Shaku Brother's!"
Thump, thump!
Teto, pulling on the spear, slammed his fist into Jin's chin. Jin also threw a punch in retaliation, but there was a gap in the basic strength between him and Teto.
The brothers felt something was off at that very moment.
'Why isn't he using Muta's runes? Brother Jin isn't the type to give up victory so easily.'
'His unique stubbornness isn't showing either. He's just getting beaten without any resistance, isn't he?'
Anger.
The sudden demonic transformation that began after the duel with Teto started. Jin was unable to focus on the battle due to resisting it.
To be precise, he couldn't even pay attention to it. Jin had already lost his reason.
All the Tuto siblings, except Teto, recognized this fact.
"It seems that it's too difficult to evaluate Jin brother's skills any further. It would be best to stop this for now."
At the moment Belize was about to step in, Baltirok grabbed her shoulder.
"No, let's keep watching for a bit longer. Seven Tuto brothers."

"Jin brother's suppressing energy is quickly fading, One Two Tuto brothers. Twelve Tuto brothers are unaware of Jin brother's condition and are being careless. If Jin brother releases the suppression, Sigmund will pierce Teto brother's chest."
"Still, I want to trust Jin brother. The God of War brothers must have foreseen this situation as well..."
Baltirok, who was speaking up to that point, quickly threw himself forward.
The other Tuto siblings did the same. What Belize worried about happened.
In the end, Jin's suppression was released, and Sigmund, filled with energy beyond the rules of the sibling duel, flew toward Teto's chest.
No matter how fast the Tuto siblings were, it was an impossible speed to stop. To begin with, the distance between Jin and Teto was only a single step.
"Hup!"
The reason Teto, unlike the other Tuto siblings, didn't recognize Jin's condition was that he was so focused.
He also had faith in Jin as his brother. Teto, as he said, was only teasing with his words, but he loved and trusted his siblings more than anyone else.
He was certain that no matter what happened during the duel, Jin would never stab him.
"Ugh, hu, huck...!"
Fortunately.
The rushing siblings were able to confirm that Jin's sword stopped just before it pierced Teto's chest.
Jin gasped for breath, barely regaining his sanity, and the rushing Tuto siblings also breathed a sigh of relief and patted their chests.
Jingle!
Jin, who reflexively drew his sword, was sweating cold sweat like rain.
And while his siblings surrounded and hugged him, offering comforting words, Jin recalled one fact.
The moment when the demonic transformation began, and the previously overwhelming Teto's spear was clearly visible.
